scope: Focused report-only editorial and representative-source review of all 20 issues in the prior deeper-review group. No project execution, tests, publication, issue comments or closures. Not a security, legal or exhaustive provenance certification.

issues.title: Mole
issues.findings: Substantive Bash cleanup and Go disk-analysis source. GPLv3 LICENSE. README explicitly combines CleanMyMac-style workflows. List the CLI only: the native Mole for Mac app is a separate proprietary product. No file-format or application compatibility established.

issues.title: LuLu
issues.findings: Substantive Objective-C Network Extension filtering, rules and alert implementation. GPLv3 LICENSE.md. Official documentation supports outgoing-connection filtering and per-application decisions. A bounded Little Snitch alternative, not established full parity or rule-format compatibility.

issues.title: Materializr
issues.findings: Substantive C++ OpenCASCADE modeling source, including extrusion. GPLv3 with explicit section-7 app-store and platform-SDK permissions; earlier MIT versions retain their terms. Current site describes its own parametric workflow and .mzr format. The issue supplies a Shapr3D inspiration claim, but native Shapr3D project compatibility is not established.

issues.title: SketchForge PCB
issues.recommendation: Accepted by maintainer as a broader Tinkercad Circuits alternative
issues.findings: Added SketchForge PCB with top-side routing and lack of Tinkercad-style simulation/Arduino execution stated in the listing.

issues.title: Inca
issues.recommendation: Recommend addition with licensing documentation follow-up
issues.findings: Explicit Maya 2020 workflow target; substantive Rust Maya ASCII importer/exporter and MEL interpreter. .mb is unsupported. README and Cargo workspace declare MIT, but no standalone license file was present in the complete 88-entry tree. Do not describe this as Unlicensed just because automated detection is empty; ask author to supply the declared MIT text. Website FAQ still denies .ma support while current source implements it, so scope must be pinned to source and not assumed released. Old v3ai URL resolves to RX-7-GTC/inca.

issues.title: ravynOS
issues.recommendation: Accepted by the maintainer and added to the held PR
issues.findings: Published clean-room contribution rules and sampled source origins support inclusion. Added for macOS application interfaces with Darwin/FreeBSD foundations, component-specific licenses and pre-alpha compatibility limits. See the focused provenance review.

issues.title: JumpStart 3D
issues.findings: Original classyapps2026 repository contains substantive modular JavaScript source and MIT LICENSE. Its version module says 2.0. Beginner source includes the shape-modeling implementation. Max Sikorski explicitly maintains a separate community fork; additions and combined work are now AGPL-3.0-only while original code stays MIT. Use original repository and credit J.Siwek; do not label the fork a mirror or mix its newer features into the original snapshot. Official site could not be read with web tooling, so current hosted-version parity remains unverified.

issues.title: OpenIDEA
issues.recommendation: Accepted and added to the held PR with maintainer approval
issues.findings: OpenIDEA is accepted as an IntelliJ IDEA implementation. Apache-2.0 licensing and substantive Rust/TypeScript implementation are documented. Its database tools and Spring-aware HTTP client address the existing Ultimate target. The previous hold based on licensed component reuse is withdrawn.

issues.title: SimpleScreenRecorder for Wayland
issues.findings: Original is already GPLv3 open-source software. A Wayland rewrite or port does not qualify without an explicit scope exception. No need to assert whether its author has retired.

issues.title: Modern BlueGriffon
issues.recommendation: Decline or redirect to existing Dreamweaver request
issues.findings: Original describes itself as open source and carries MPL-2.0 LICENSE. Modernizing that application is normally outside scope. Its WYSIWYG webpage/newsletter requirements can inform the existing Dreamweaver request without relabeling BlueGriffon as proprietary.

issues.title: Meshroom for macOS in Rust
issues.findings: COPYING.md explicitly licenses Meshroom under MPL2 and lists third-party licenses. Language/platform preference is not a proprietary target. No scope exception inferred.

issues.title: CloudCraft
issues.findings: Target Synology Drive file sharing, versions, sync, access controls and self-hosting workflows. Existing Synology DSM request is broader and does not precisely identify Drive. Nextcloud can be an open-source reference, not an original to reimplement under normal policy. Google Drive and Dropbox should only become additional targets if specific workflows are retained, not automatically from the generic list.

issues.title: PlasmaCraft
issues.recommendation: Accept SheetCAM request and enrich ProNest
issues.findings: Specific DXF/SVG-to-G-code single-part plasma workflows, kerf/material presets, preview and rapid edits. SheetCAM is a concrete separate commercial CAM target; ProNest already has a request. Add a SheetCAM request and merge applicable nesting/process details into ProNest. SC2000 appears as a workflow reference, not an independently established additional target.

issues.title: STAAD.Pro
issues.findings: Existing bentley-suite request explicitly includes STAAD.Pro structural analysis. Add useful loading, results and steel/concrete design workflow details there, then close as covered. A dedicated STAAD target would be optional taxonomy work, not necessary to resolve the submission.

issues.title: Nuke Studio
issues.recommendation: Accept distinct request or explicitly expand existing Nuke scope
issues.findings: Foundry identifies Nuke Studio as NukeX plus Hiero with editorial timeline and multi-shot management. Current request only explicitly targets Nuke/NukeX compositing. Do not close as an exact duplicate without preserving Studio editorial/conform/version-management workflows. Recommend a separate Nuke Studio target/request for clarity.

issues.title: ActiveChroma
issues.findings: Existing Synapse request only mentions peripheral configuration, macros, DPI, profiles and lighting generally. Chroma app/game integration and audio/screen-reactive synchronized effects are a distinct defined software/interface target. Include independent control plus optional documented SDK/API compatibility; do not imply all third-party devices work.

issues.title: HP original-ink detection removal
issues.findings: As written this asks for a tool modifying/disabling original firmware checks, without a printer model or defined independent driver/firmware target. Recommend decline under editorial scope or invite a concrete independent target. No legal conclusion about cartridge refilling or firmware modification is made.

issues.title: Android and iPhone unlocking
issues.findings: Issue contains only a title asking for unlocking software, without a product, ownership/use context, or observable compatibility target. Do not assume whether this means bootloader unlock, carrier unlock or screen-lock removal.

issues.title: StreamFab
issues.findings: Concrete proprietary product exists, but official site includes dedicated DRM downloaders and subscription-streaming downloads. The issue does not distinguish independent download-management workflows from access-control circumvention or modifying the original app. Ask which independently implemented workflows are wanted; no blanket legal determination is made.

issues.title: PrnCraft and CraftFans
issues.findings: No actual functionality or compatibility target beyond platform names and a desire for free access. Existing suggested professional response remains appropriate. No additional message or closure performed.
